sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: The City of Gliwice invites entries for a one-stage urban planning, landscape, and architectural design competition to develop a development concept for the Kłodnica Boulevards in Gliwice. The goal of the competition is to obtain a high-quality urban planning, landscape, and architectural concept for the Kłodnica River valley within the city limits of Gliwice. We are seeking visionary solutions that will transform the riverside corridor into a vibrant, multifunctional public space, integrate urban green spaces into a cohesive natural system, create safe walking and biking routes, and strengthen the city’s resilience to climate change.
